sentences.text: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge

The appellants have preferred an appeal under Section 52 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1990 against order dated 07.03.2024 passed by the court of learned Principal District Judge, Kathua in Reference under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, in which this Court vide order dated 27.03.2024 has issued notice to the respondents and the record of the reference court has also been summoned.

The specific case of the learned counsel appearing for the appellants is that during pendency of the aforesaid appeal, the respondents have issued notice dated 06.04.2024 to the legal heirs of Om Parkash, whereby they have been informed that the Collector Land Acquisition may take possession of the land in question any time after the expiry of 48 hours from serving of the said notice.

According to the learned counsel for the appellants, the issue which is pending adjudication in the instant appeal is that the appellants have been paid compensation only for the structure comprising Dabha and till date, assessment of the residential construction has neither been done nor paid.
The petitioner has placed strong reliance on the assessment done by the concerned Executing Engineer, Kathua, in which assessment of the structure of only Dabha has been done.

Learned counsel further submits that the appellants have not been compensated for the residential construction as unlike the assessment to Jagdish Mitter, whose assessment includes construction of both shop and the house.

Thus, according to the learned counsel for the appellants, the appellants have been treated step motherly and discriminated without any justifiable cause as the respondents have failed to give compensation for the residential construction.

Learned counsel further submits that after the respondent is being made aware about the filing of the instant appeal and passing of Kashyap Pal And Others vs Respondent(S) on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119029575/
1 order dated 27.03.2024, the respondent with a view to frustrate the impending possession in the aforesaid appeal, has issued the impugned notice, which has been called in question in the instant application, whereby the appellants have been informed that the respondent is going to take possession of the residential building/house of the appellants after the expiry of 48 hours from the service of the said notice.

sentences.text: 2. It is the specific case of the appellants in the instant appeal, since no compensation with respect to the residential building owned and possessed by the appellants constructed over the land has been assessed nor paid to the appellants, therefore, according to Mr. Ankesh Chandel, learned counsel appearing for the appellants, the respondent is not legally entitled to take decision of the said residential structure/building including the land owned by the appellants.

He further submits that if the impugned notice is allowed to acted upon then the very purpose for filing the appeal will stand forfeited and the appeal will be rendered infructuous and irreparable loss will be caused to the appellants which cannot be compensated by any means whatsoever.
3.
Heard learned counsel for the appellants at length and perused the record.

4. Issue notice to the respondents in CM No. 1976/2024.
5.
In the meantime, the impugned notice dated ADCK/LAS/2024-25/01-09 dated 06.04.2024 issued by the Collector Land Acquisition, Kathua shall remain stayed.
7. Alteration/Modification/Vacation on motion.
(A(WASIM SADIQ NARGAL) JUDGE Jammu 12.04.2024
